title: Identical [deploy.container] block duplicated across four target lambdas
description: The exact four-line container block ([deploy.container] / registry = "" / port = 8080 / base_image = "python:3.11.9-slim") is repeated verbatim in the toml_section lambdas for the 'container', 'azure-container-apps', 'aws-ecs', and 'gcp-run' targets (4 copies). A shared module-level constant (e.g. _CONTAINER_TOML) prepended to the target-specific sub-table would remove the duplication and guarantee the four stay in sync (today a change to port/base_image must be edited in four places). The Grep over `[deploy.container]` confirms exactly four occurrences at lines 60, 87, 117, 145.
evidence:
Lines 60-64, 87-90, 117-120, 145-148 each contain `[deploy.container]
registry = ""
port = 8080
base_image = "python:3.11.9-slim"`. Confirmed 4 matches via Grep.
behavior_preservation: Pure refactor: concatenating a shared constant produces byte-identical TOML output; all existing TOML-parse tests (test_*_toml_parses, test_all_targets_produce_valid_toml) continue to pass.
